agri_cooperation.status_note: GR/document listing at https://agri.gujarat.gov.in/GR is rendered client-side via JS/AJAX -- plain HTTP requests see an empty page shell. Using a real browser (Playwright) to execute that JS instead triggers the site's WAF, which detects headless-browser fingerprints and returns either a math CAPTCHA ("Security check... enter the above result") or a hard block ("Web Page Blocked, Attack ID: 20000021"). Plain requests are NOT blocked on these same domains -- confirmed by re-testing immediately after. Getting past this requires either solving a CAPTCHA or evading headless-browser detection, both of which are circumventing a deliberate anti-bot control and were not attempted.
agri_cooperation.last_fetch_method: plain requests (empty JS shell) + Playwright (WAF/CAPTCHA-blocked); no working method found
